title: lobelia tomentosa var. paucidentata
intro: Lobelia tomentosa var. paucidentata, commonly known as American Indian tobacco, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its use as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and cough suppressant. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia tomentosa var. paucidentata include its ability to stimulate the respiratory system, relieve respiratory congestion, and reduce muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
